context: Two teens plan a market-and-parade weekend
purpose: Teach: レモン/キャベツ/ブラウン/ミラー/妖精/神秘/パレード/見舞い

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 週末、レモン市場のパレードに行こうよ!
lines.en: Come on, let's go to the lemon-market parade this weekend!
lines.style: Bright, insistent energy on the opening. Quick tempo. The kind of enthusiasm that expects you to catch up. No pause for negotiation — already planning it as a done thing.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: いいね。キャベツの新作料理も出てるって。
lines.en: Yeah, that sounds good. I heard they've got new cabbage dishes too.
lines.style: Softer, almost thinking aloud. Warm agreement that isn't trying too hard. Slight lift at the end — testing if this matters as much to her as the parade.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: お父さんへの見舞いも兼ねて、ブラウンのギフトボックスでお土産買おう。
lines.en: Plus we can visit my dad while we're there. Let's pick up a gift in one of those nice brown boxes.
lines.style: Practical but soft underneath. Matter-of-fact about the errand, but there's real care in how she tucks it into the plan. Steady delivery, like this part matters.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 屋台のミラーアートが神秘的だって聞いた。
lines.en: I heard the mirror art booth at the market is supposed to be really cool.
lines.style: Quiet observation, almost to himself. Not trying to compete with her excitement — just sharing something he noticed. Slight wonder in the tone, like he's already thinking about it.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 夜は妖精コスプレの撮影会あるよ。
lines.en: And there's a fairy-cosplay photo session at night!
lines.style: Bright spike of energy. Lighter than before — this detail delights her separately. Quick, like she can't help but say it. Expects him to feel the same pull.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.en: Yeah, I'm really looking forward to it.
lines.style: Warm, genuine agreement without overstatement. His voice settles at the end of the line — it's decided, and he's genuinely there for it. Quiet contentment underneath.
